meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 使 Claude 能按指南诊断容器代理故障,检查主机与容器日志、会话数据库、挂载配置,定位重复实例、认证失败等常见问题,并给出修复步骤。
howto.when: 当用户报告容器不工作、容器启动失败、认证出错,或想弄清容器系统的工作方式时,触发该技能。

say.text: NanoClaw 容器没回复,帮我查日志和会话数据库。
检查一下是否有重复的 NanoClaw 服务在运行。
say.note: 会检查进程列表和系统服务。

say.text: 消息发出去没回音,看看是不是投递环节丢了。
say.note: 会核对 outbound 数据库与平台消息 ID。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to diagnose container agent failures by checking host and container logs, session databases, mount configurations, and common issues like duplicate instances or auth failures, and to provide fix steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user reports container problems, startup failures, authentication issues, or asks how the container system works.

say_en.text: Container not replying—check logs and session DBs.
say_en.note: Follows the skill: error log first, then session DBs.

say_en.text: Check if a duplicate NanoClaw service is running.
say_en.note: Checks process list and systemd units.
Verifies outbound.db and platform message IDs.
